cases.description: Assistant Professors in Computer Science and Mechanical Engineering have not received their 7th CPC scale salaries for the past 6 months. Compulsory deductions made but PF not deposited into EPFO.
cases.nextAction: Review institution bank statement and EPFO compliance receipt
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Best expertise match (Faculty Salary), lowest active workload ratio (4/10) in Regulation Bureau (RB).
cases.findings: Preliminary inspection notice dispatched. College management submitted partial reply acknowledging delayed disbursement due to pending state grants.

cases.description: Non-payment of gratuity, earned leave encashment, and 5 months unpaid arrears for resigned faculty members who served between 2021-2025. Original certificates of faculty being withheld by management.
cases.nextAction: Summon management representative regarding withholding original degree certificates
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Assigned to lead officer Dr. Ananya Sen for Common Issue Group GRP-2026-001.
cases.findings: Direct violation of AICTE Regulation 2019 Clause 4.2 identified regarding withholding of teacher documents.

cases.description: Management has uploaded fictional faculty profiles on the AICTE web portal for the Extension of Approval (EoA) 2026-27 inspection, using Aadhaar credentials of persons who never taught at the campus.
cases.nextAction: Physical Surprise Inspection committee recommendation to Apex Council
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Expertise match (Faculty Qualifications & Ghost Faculty) in Regulation Bureau (RB).
cases.findings: Biometric verification records show discrepancy of 14 faculty members between portal declaration and physical muster rolls.

cases.description: Refusal to refund admission security deposit and first-term tuition fee (Rs 1,35,000) for student admitted through lateral entry who withdrew before AICTE cutoff date.
cases.nextAction: Notice issued to Registrar seeking fee refund calculation voucher
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: PGRC specialist with lowest workload ratio (3/8).

cases.description: CAD/CAM laboratory software licenses expired 18 months ago. Students forced to complete final-year design projects without functional licensed design suites.
cases.complainantName: Final Year B.Tech ME Student Representatives
cases.nextAction: Verify software renewal invoice uploaded by college
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Infrastructure expertise match in Regulation Bureau (RB).
cases.findings: College submitted quotation for Dassault SolidWorks campus pack.

cases.description: End semester internal assessment marks manipulated after submission to university portal.
cases.nextAction: Case Closed - Transferred to affiliating university Examination Controller
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Examination expertise match in PGRC.
cases.findings: Matter pertains to university internal evaluation rules. Forwarded to AKTU Controller of Examinations.
cases.disposalRemarks: Disposed after formal transfer to affiliating university. Student notified via SMS & Portal.

cases.institutionName: National Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences
cases.description: Demand of unapproved "Infrastructure Development Fee" of Rs 60,000 per student during admission counseling under management quota.
cases.nextAction: Issue show cause notice under AICTE Prohibition of Capitation Fee Regulations
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Capitation Fee specialist in PGRC.
cases.findings: Receipts collected from 12 parents confirming illegal development charges levied.

cases.institutionName: National Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences
cases.description: Compulsory Rs 40,000 laptop bundle fee collected with tuition fees without offering option for self-procurement, violating student charter.
cases.nextAction: Draft directive requiring college to make hardware optional
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Student Welfare & PGRC specialist, workload 2/8.
cases.findings: College admitted fee was bundled. Agreed to offer opt-out in next semester.

cases.institutionName: National Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences
cases.description: Admitting students beyond AICTE approved intake of 180 seats in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science program.
cases.nextAction: Escalated to Member Secretary AICTE for intake penalty hearing
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Approval Bureau lead specialist with Admission Malpractice expertise.
cases.findings: Enrollment registry lists 214 students against sanctioned intake of 180 (excess of 34 seats).

cases.institutionName: National Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences
cases.description: Arbitrary reduction of summer vacation leave and maternity leave denial to ad-hoc women assistant professors.
cases.nextAction: Issue notice regarding compliance with Maternity Benefit Act & AICTE Faculty Service Regulations
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Faculty Development Cell cadre expert, workload 2/8.

cases.institutionName: National Institute of Engineering & Applied Sciences
cases.description: Hostel ragging incident reported by first year hostel boarders; anti-ragging squad took no FIR action.
cases.nextAction: Closed - FIR lodged and warden suspended
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Anti-ragging ombudsman in PGRC.
cases.findings: Direct AICTE intervention prompted immediate police report and disciplinary action against perpetrators.
cases.disposalRemarks: Institutional inquiry concluded, 4 senior students suspended for 2 semesters, police FIR registered.

cases.institutionName: St. Jude College of Engineering & Research
cases.description: Delay in disbursing 6th CPC arrears and withholding of DA revisions approved in 2023 for teaching and technical staff.
cases.nextAction: Escalate to Senior Officer for withholding of institution grant
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Regulation Bureau salary specialist, workload 5/10.
cases.findings: Audit team verified 14-month delay in DA arrear settlement.

cases.institutionName: St. Jude College of Engineering & Research
cases.description: Fire safety certificate expired in August 2025; multi-story chemical laboratory block functioning without operational hydrant system.
cases.nextAction: Issue immediate emergency compliance summons to Chief Fire Officer and Principal
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Safety & compliance expert Dr. Harish Chandra (currently 5/5 cases).
cases.findings: Fire audit report confirmed major safety defects in Block C.

cases.institutionName: St. Jude College of Engineering & Research
cases.description: Non-disclosure of vacant NRI quota seats to CAP rounds, filling vacant seats directly without merit list.
cases.nextAction: Request Maharashtra CET Cell merit list comparison
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Approval Bureau admission specialist.

cases.institutionName: St. Jude College of Engineering & Research
cases.description: Delay in issuing re-evaluation marksheets causing loss of employment opportunities for graduated batch.
cases.nextAction: Case Closed
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: PGRC Officer Shri Vikramaditya Rao.
cases.findings: Marksheets printed and handed over on 10th of last month.
cases.disposalRemarks: Affiliating university resolved printing backlog. Confirmed received by complainants.

cases.description: Institution operating diploma civil engineering program with only 2 permanent instructors instead of required 8. Fake faculty records maintained for inspections.
cases.nextAction: Pending approval by Senior Advisor for withdrawal of diploma approval
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Vigilance specialist in Regulation Bureau (RB).
cases.findings: Physical inspection team found 6 instructors absent without approved leave for over 90 days.

cases.description: Workshops lack basic lathe machines, welding booths, and electrical testing benches mandated by AICTE Diploma Curricula.
cases.nextAction: Depute surprise technical verification officer
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Dr. Harish Chandra (Safety & Compliance).
cases.findings: Equipment purchase vouchers dated 2021 have no physical presence in workshop stock registers.

cases.description: Security caution money of Rs 15,000 not returned to students completing their diploma in 2025.
cases.nextAction: Awaiting Administrator / Supervisor Assignment
cases.assignmentReason: Held in Unassigned Queue: Eligible PGRC officer Shri Devendra Prasad is On Leave.

cases.description: Operating in rented non-educational commercial space without valid land title deed conversion.
cases.nextAction: Case Closed
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Land & Building Norms specialist Smt. Meenakshi Sundaram.
cases.findings: Institution produced approved land conversion document from District Collectorate.
cases.disposalRemarks: Documents verified and found compliant with AICTE Land Norms 2024.

cases.institutionName: Vidya Sagar Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences
cases.description: Animal House and pharmacology testing laboratory do not meet CPCSEA and AICTE standards. Non-functional air handling units (AHU).
cases.nextAction: Joint inspection scheduled with Pharmacy Council representatives
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Dr. Harish Chandra (Safety & Compliance).
cases.findings: Notice served to management to rectify AHU filtration within 14 working days.

cases.institutionName: Vidya Sagar Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences
cases.description: Non-disbursement of provident fund and delays in payment of guest lecturer honorarium.
cases.nextAction: Dispatch standard clarification notice
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Regulation Bureau salary expert, workload 5/10.

cases.institutionName: Vidya Sagar Institute of Pharmaceutical Sciences
cases.description: Running unapproved diploma program concurrently in the same building during evening hours without separate AICTE clearance.
cases.nextAction: Case Closed
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Approval Bureau Norms specialist.
cases.findings: Program found to be an authorized skill certification under PMKVY, not an unapproved diploma.
cases.disposalRemarks: Clarification submitted by institute validated against NSDC registration.

cases.description: Admission of 45 students without qualifying CMAT/CAT/KMAT test score in MBA program.
cases.nextAction: Seek scorecards validation from testing agency
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Approval Bureau intake expert Prof. K. V. Raman.
cases.findings: Preliminary verification shows 18 candidates lack qualifying entrance exam roll numbers.

cases.description: Termination of 3 senior Associate Professors without 3-month statutory notice or inquiry committee.
cases.nextAction: Issue notice to Chairman of Governing Body
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Faculty Development Cell cadre specialist Dr. Farooq Ahmed.

cases.description: Delay in refunding caution deposit of Rs 25,000 upon course completion.
cases.nextAction: Case Closed
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: PGRC ombudsman Dr. Sunita Kulkarni.
cases.findings: Cheque issued by college accounts and deposited into complainant bank account.
cases.disposalRemarks: Complainant confirmed receipt of Rs 25,000. Case closed happily.

cases.description: Shortage of CAD drafting studios and architectural model workshops required under CoA-AICTE composite guidelines.
cases.nextAction: Joint assessment with Council of Architecture
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Dr. Harish Chandra (Safety & Compliance).
cases.findings: Studio area falls short by 120 sq. meters according to AICTE Approval Process Handbook (APH).

cases.description: Design chairs and adjunct professors withheld visiting compensation for 2 academic terms.
cases.nextAction: Issue routine inquiry letter to finance officer
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Regulation Bureau salary specialist Smt. Preeti Deshmukh.

cases.institutionName: Deccan Valley Academy of Science & Technology
cases.description: Allegations of spot-round admission fee irregularities during academic year 2025-26.
cases.nextAction: Case Closed
cases.assignmentReason: Auto-assigned: Smt. Meenakshi Sundaram (Approval Bureau).
cases.findings: All spot-round admissions found to match TS-EAMCET rank lists strictly.
cases.disposalRemarks: Allegations unsubstantiated upon cross-checking state counseling merit data.
